Contract AirportSystem::createDevice(id: Integer,name: String,location: String,contactsid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		device: Device = Device.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		staff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = contactsid)
	precondition:
		device.oclIsUndefined() or
		staff.oclIsUndefined()
	postcondition:
		let newDevice: Device in
		newDevice.oclIsNew() and
		Device.allInstance()->includes(newDevice) and
		newDevice.Name = name and
		newDevice.Location = location and
		newDevice.Contacts = staff and
		result = true
}
